answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 6851 Country: India Title: What is the difference betwwen Nabi and Rasool? Question: Dear Asssalaoaliakum What is the difference betwwen Nabi and Rasool? Answer ID: 6851 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1471/1279=B/1429) Rasool (messenger) is one who is given new Shariah and new divine book while a Nabi (prophet) is not granted new divine book but he preaches according to his previous messenger. Note : There are some more definitions and differences between prophet and messenger which can be seen in Nibrah (the commentary of Sharh Aqaaid). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
